title: Grateful Dead Live at Fox Theatre on 1970-02-02

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture highlighting a superb Dark Star → St. Stephen sequence.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as an "excellent" soundboard source that sounds fresh and detailed, delivering a beautiful Dark Star that flows seamlessly into St. Stephen before the brief Mason's Children excerpt. Reviewers rave about the musical performance of those two jams, calling the set a hidden gem worth downloading despite the show date being unknown.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviewers are enthusiastic (4‑5 stars) and specifically highlight both superb soundboard quality and standout Dark Star/St. Stephen performances, indicating an exceptional overall experience.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear mix with no noticeable hiss or distortion; reviewers describe it as sounding like a fresh afternoon board recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show is noted for its seamless Dark Star → St. Stephen transition, with a brief Mason's Children fade that doesn't detract from the main jam.
